text:
Maya (Finance): Quick heads-up — we've updated the expense receipt policy and the exceptions flow for Q4. Please read and follow the new steps starting today. :mega:

Liam (Procurement): What changed exactly?

Maya (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Digital receipts required for any card transaction > $25; 2) Vendor onboarding spend > $10k now needs FP&A pre-approval; 3) Emergency exceptions are allowed but must use the new 'ProcureFlow' quick form and include a manager + FP&A signoff.

Jesse (FP&A): Adding: if a vendor contract commit is multi-month and totals > $25k, route to finance-contracts@redwood for review before PO issuance.

ProcurementBot: Automated reminder — new ProcureFlow form: https://company.internal/forms/procureflow (use this for exception requests). Responses trigger a ticket in #procurement-triage.

Asha (Eng): For virtual cards, do limits change? We have recurring infra subscriptions that charge ~$800/mo.

Liam (Procurement): Good question — virtual card monthly single-charge limit increases to $2,000 for pre-approved subscriptions. For anything recurring or vendor-managed billing, we still need the onboarding checklist + signed SOW if > $5k total.

Maya (Finance): Example flows: `one-off < $2k` = submit expense with receipt; `vendor onboarding $2k-$10k` = procurement + manager; `>$10k` = procurement + FP&A pre-approval.

Sam (Ops): If we already submitted an expense that doesn't meet the new receipt requirement, do we need to resubmit?

Maya (Finance): No need to resubmit historical charges before today. For new charges, we'll reject expenses missing a digital receipt and mark them for manual review. Exceptions are rare — use ProcureFlow.

Jesse (FP&A): Reminder: PO and vendor-contract windows are measured on the expected total spend at contract signing, not monthly amounts.

Asha (Eng): Noted. Is there a one-pager?

Maya (Finance): Yes — consolidated doc with flowcharts and examples: https://company.internal/docs/finance/expense-exception-flow (attached in the doc is a checklist and the approval matrix). Please skim and flag any product subscriptions that need grandfathering. :thumbsup:

Liam (Procurement): We'll run a quick sweep of active vendor cards this week and ping teams for missing docs. Expect DM from me if something pops.

ProcurementBot: Deploy notice — this policy update was recorded in the policy registry (v2.3) and emailed to all managers.

Asha (Eng): Thanks — will audit our team card this afternoon. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone. If you have edge cases, tag me or submit ProcureFlow. We'll share a short FAQ tomorrow in #finance. :sparkles:
